name: building-ground-plane
description: test.md 'The WE's own ground under buildings differs from bilinear': units stored at 999 on a plane rising 16 a tile east and 8 north (fixtures/we-specs/make-building-ground.mjs), opened and saved, SD. The editor saves a building on the highest of the four points 16 times its Scaling Value from its centre, turned with its facing (merchant 2 above the point under it at facings 0, 90, 270 and 2.121 at 45; farm 1.7; mercenary camp 1.6; a merchant with Scaling Value 2 4); the gold mine and anything without Art - Elevation - Sample Points (uept) on the point under it, a gold mine given 4 points like the merchant; Can Build On, the abilities, Placement Prevented By, the model and the placed scale play no part. Studio's save the same (objheights.ts unitGround over the skins' elevPts, collision, building and modelScale)

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units?.length; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); window.__driveEd.pushEdit({ undo() {}, redo() {}, terrain: false, objects: false });
